title: Build a safe tool-using assistant
prompt: Provide a small set of read-only tools for calculations and public data lookup. Validate every request, enforce caller permissions, and log tool outcomes.

starter.response_template:
Objective:
Input/data:
Method:
Expected behavior:
Test cases:
Results and limitations:

public_tests.name: has_required_sections
public_tests.description: Submit a brief report with objective, inputs, method, expected behavior, test cases, and limitations.

acceptance_criteria: The submission states a concrete objective and describes its input data.
The method is reproducible and appropriate for the chosen task.
At least three representative test cases and their results are recorded.
Limitations, privacy/security implications, and next steps are explicitly documented.
hints: Start with a small synthetic or public dataset and a fixed task definition.
Write measurable acceptance criteria before running the model or pipeline.
Record failed examples as well as successful examples; do not infer correctness from fluency.
status_note: Reference solution is repository-only. Static keyword grading is only a preliminary check; a reviewer must assess the practical behavior before publication.
